text.en:
Guarding with Sentinel Shield blinds enemies within <pve 7 /> <pvp [3.5] /> metres for 5 seconds.

Your Ward of Dawn grants Starless Night, granting all allies that enter a 65 HP Void Overshield for [?] seconds.

Enemies that enter your Ward of Dawn are also blinded for 5 seconds.
text.ko:
깃발 방패로 막으면 7미터 이내에 있는 적들을 5초간 실명시킵니다.

새벽의 수호물을 시전하면 별 없는 밤이 활성화되며 수호물에 들어온 아군에게 65HP 짜리 보호막을 부여합니다.

수호물에 들어온 적들을 5초간 실명시킵니다.

Guarding with Sentinel Shield disorients enemies within <pve 7 /> <pvp [3.5] /> meters for 5 seconds.

You and allies inside your Ward of Dawn receive 'Armor of Light' and 'Weapons of Light'. Enemies that enter your Ward of Dawn are disoriented for 5 seconds.

'Armor of Light' grants a 45 HP <void/>Void Overshield for ? seconds upon leaving the <void/>Ward of Dawn.

'Weapons of Light' grants 25% increased weapon damage (<link Empowering Buff [#DamageBuffs] />) for ? seconds.

Weapons of Light from <void/>Ward of Dawn can now persist outside the bubble for 15 seconds.

While Weapons of Light is active: 
• Gain stacks of 'The Saint' by dealing damage or scoring kills against enemies. Stacks granted by kill are based off <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />, with Minor Tier enemies granting 1, Elite Tier enemies granting 2, and Miniboss+ enemies granting 3. Stacks granted on hit are granted after dealing ? damage. 
Maximum of 14 stacks. Stack duration is equal to the remaining duration of your currently active <void/>Ward of Dawn.

• Kills or dealing ? damage with a <kinetic/>Kinetic or <void/>Void element triggers a <void/>Suppressing Blast in a 6? meter radius around the target, applying <void/>Suppression for <pve 6 /> <pvp [?] /> seconds. 

Picking up your <void/>Ward of Dawn consumes all stacks of The Saint, and extends its active timer by ? seconds per stack consumed. Stacks can no longer be earned or consumed once the <void/>Ward of Dawn has been relocated two times.
